Shipping & Delivery Policy

This policy outlines the shipping and delivery expectations for buyers and vendors on the Shopyos marketplace.

Last updated: August 19, 2026

1. Fulfillment Model

  • Shopyos is a direct-to-consumer marketplace. We do not hold inventory or operate a centralized fulfillment center.
  • All products are shipped directly from the third-party vendor to the buyer.

2. Vendor Shipping Responsibilities

  • Dispatch Times: Vendors are expected to process and dispatch orders within the timeframe specified on their product listing (typically 1–3 business days).
  • Logistics Partners: Vendors may use local couriers, logistics companies, or their own dispatch riders to fulfill orders.
  • Tracking & Updates: Vendors must provide dispatch confirmations, delivery tracking information (if applicable), and status updates directly through the Shopyos vendor dashboard.

3. Buyer Delivery Information

  • Buyers must ensure that their delivery address and contact information are accurate at checkout.
  • Shipping costs are determined by the vendor and calculated at checkout based on the buyer’s location and the delivery method selected.

4. Delivery Confirmation & Escrow

  • Funds paid by the buyer are held in a secure Shopyos escrow account.
  • The vendor's payment is only released for settlement after the buyer confirms successful delivery, or after the standard inspection window has passed without a dispute being raised.
